signature.name: Already-pouring first frame
signature.description: Whether the loader already shows coffee being made in the first frame a customer sees after tapping order, at 120px, judged from a restart at 0, 100 and 250ms.

lesson: Strong coffee loaders show the pour already happening in the first frame and keep the motion steady and countable; weak ones open on an empty cup, a spinner, or a glitch that reads as a fault.

bare-wire.signature_why: A full crema cup shows at 0ms and a dark hole opens by 250ms, but nothing is visibly pouring until the scar appears.
bare-wire.loved: The top-down cup with its handle reads as coffee at a glance, and the calm one-beat rhythm has no spinner rotation.
bare-wire.docked: The dark hole reads as a pothole or a stall more than coffee arriving, so a half-awake glance does not say 'coming'.
bare-wire.fix_note: The drip stroke was refused as a second subject outside the cup; the team enlarged and held the scar instead.

warm-hands.signature_why: The pour is already mid-stroke at 0ms with the pour tip in place, and the 0ms frame matches the 5s frame, so a restart looks like a continuation.
warm-hands.loved: It looks like someone is pouring, not loading: the cup, handle, pour tip and stain say coffee, and nothing flashes.
warm-hands.docked: The rotating spiral still reads as a spinner or cinnamon roll at 120px, and the thin stream is too faint to carry the pour alone.
warm-hands.fix_note: The stream landed as a fixed line down to the pivot, not from the rim to the moving tip, so it reads as a pour but not a travelling one.

the-glitch.signature_why: At 0ms the cup is dark with no drop yet; a drop is visibly at the spout by 250ms, so coffee shows within a quarter-second.
the-glitch.loved: One drop a second, falling into a cup that counts up in crema, is a steady, countable wait that reads as coffee on the way.
the-glitch.docked: The crema step at beat 5 can look like a drain, and the 3s pull is a little dramatic for a half-awake glance.
the-glitch.fix_note: The orange layer was removed at every size, not just at 120px; the slip and ghost are gone and the drop and count are kept.
